answer: A $30 jetty check turns a sybil fleet away at the dock. Each epoch every identity queues at a jetty checkpoint for 90 seconds. A prism splits it into three channels no recording fakes, an echo, a gesture, and typed cadence, each scored by its own warden. The echo is a fresh six word phrase to repeat in two seconds, so replays die on timing. Clones on one device pay $30 times n each, so 100 clones cost $151,500 versus $3,000 for 100 honest agents. Wardens recheck a tenth daily. A failed echo voids the identity and bars its device ten epochs. One pier, one window, one tide for real boats.
